source_evidence: These benefits can include tax deductions (e.g., pre-tax contributions), tax-deferred growth (no taxes until withdrawal), and/or tax-free withdrawals.
question: Misconception: All tax-advantaged retirement accounts let you withdraw money tax-free. What is the correction?
answer: Tax benefits vary by account. They can include tax deductions, tax-deferred growth, and/or tax-free withdrawals, so tax-free withdrawals are not necessarily a feature of every tax-advantaged retirement account.
